name: Its a thing to hold on keyguards

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a thin, elongated magnetic attachment bracket designed for a keyboard case. It features a wide, flat base plate with rounded corners and a secondary raised step or lip running along part of its length. On the underside of this lip, there are circular pocket cutouts near the left and right ends meant to house small cylindrical magnets, while a large rectangular cutout spans the center section to reduce weight.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric keyboard magnetic attachment bracket in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a thin, rounded rectangular base plate, a raised guide lip, and cylindrical pocket cutouts at both ends of the lip for embedding magnets, with a large central rectangular cutout to save material.
captions.factory: The design is built using a custom helper module 'roundedRect' which creates 2D rounded rectangles using circle and hull, then extrudes them. The base consists of two stacked roundedRect shapes of different widths and heights. A third roundedRect layer is shifted and combined using difference operations to subtract four cylinder shapes for the magnet pockets at specific end coordinates, and a large central cube to create the weight-reduction slot.
